svg.aria-label: Building a Merkle tree. The data is split into blocks A, B, C and D. Each block is hashed: H(A), H(B), H(C), H(D). Pairs of hashes are concatenated and hashed again: H(AB) from H(A) and H(B), H(CD) from H(C) and H(D). Finally H(AB) and H(CD) are hashed into the root hash. Changing any single byte in any block changes its leaf hash, every hash above it, and the root.
